text: In 2021, Derf Backderf's My Friend Dahmer was removed as an option from a high school reading list in Leander, Texas. The decision was later reversed, and the book became available again on the condition that students receive counseling on its content. An elementary school parent asked the Catawba County schools to remove the book.
